digest.component_or_area: Janitor cleanup and codebase-health audit remediation
propositions: Code-review provenance (--ref/--source) must flow through to CodeReviewRequest and results must include source and verified_at_sha fields like other producers
Snapshot-entry contract enforcement must move from ADR assertion to CI validation
Exit-codes documentation must cover all dispatcher arms and emitted codes, maintained by CI
LLM attestation and review cycle stale when origin/main advances during serialized review-plan/completion-verify/code-review pipeline
CLI and MCP must share one unified implementation of the retryable-state rule (passed but unsigned)
Deprecated config files must honour the deprecation registry behavior field
